mapper.sql: SELECT d.wo_id, i.material_id, d.biz_date, CASE WHEN d.kind = 'RETURN' THEN -i.qty ELSE i.qty END AS qty FROM mes_wo_doc d JOIN mes_wo_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id JOIN mes_work_order w ON w.id = d.wo_id AND w.material_id <> i.material_id WHERE d.kind IN ('ISSUE', 'SUPPLEMENT', 'RETURN') AND d.biz_date < #{next}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS wo_id, o.wo_no, o.status, o.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.unit, c.finished_qty, c.hours, c.material_cost AS actual_material, c.labor_cost AS actual_labor, c.overhead_cost AS actual_overhead, c.loss_amount, CASE WHEN ps.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_std, COALESCE(ps.material_cost, 0) AS std_unit_material, COALESCE(ps.labor_cost, 0) AS std_unit_labor, COALESCE(ps.overhead_cost, 0) AS std_unit_overhead, COALESCE(ps.std_hours, 0) AS std_unit_hours, COALESCE(iss.issued_at_std, 0) AS issued_at_std, COALESCE(iss.missing_std, 0) AS missing_std FROM mes_work_order o JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = o.material_id JOIN ( SELECT wo_id, SUM(finished_qty) AS finished_qty, SUM(hours) AS hours, SUM(material_cost) AS material_cost, SUM(labor_cost) AS labor_cost, SUM(overhead_cost) AS overhead_cost, SUM(loss_amount) AS loss_amount FROM fin_wo_cost WHERE period <= #{period} GROUP BY wo_id ) c ON c.wo_id = o.id LEFT JOIN fin_std_cost ps ON ps.version_id = #{versionId} AND ps.material_id = o.material_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.wo_id, SUM(t.qty * COALESCE(sc.unit_cost, 0)) AS issued_at_std, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_std FROM ( SELECT n.wo_id, n.material_id, SUM(n.qty) AS qty FROM () n GROUP BY n.wo_id, n.material_id ) t LEFT JOIN fin_std_cost sc ON sc.version_id = #{versionId} AND sc.material_id = t.material_id GROUP BY t.wo_id ) iss ON iss.wo_id = o.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wo_id, MAX(biz_date) AS last_finish FROM mes_wo_doc WHERE kind = 'FINISH' GROUP BY wo_id ) lf ON lf.wo_id = o.id WHERE o.wo_type = 'NORMAL' AND ((o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND lf.last_finish >= #{begin} AND lf.last_finish < #{next}) OR (o.status = 'CLOSED' AND o.close_time >= #{begin} AND o.close_time < #{next})) ORDER BY o.wo_no
SELECT material_id AS "materialId", unit_qty AS "unitQty" FROM mes_wo_material WHERE wo_id = #{woId}

SELECT n.material_id AS "materialId", SUM(n.qty) AS "qty", SUM(n.qty * COALESCE(mc.unit_cost, 0)) AS "amount" FROM () n LEFT JOIN fin_material_cost mc ON mc.material_id = n.material_id AND mc.period = YEAR(n.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(n.biz_date) WHERE n.wo_id = #{woId} GROUP BY n.material_id
